name: HFCL Ltd.
about: HFCL Limited manufactures and sells telecom products in India and internationally. The company offers optical fiber cables, such as underground, aerial, microduct, FTTH, and micromodule cables; access solutions, including Wi-Fi access points, network switches, unlicensed band radios, IO canvas unified network management platform, and accessories; IP/MPLS routers; 5G product portfolio comprising access routers/cell site routers and pre-aggregation and aggregation routers; fiber optic cable and copper cable assemblies, high-density cabinets, fiber splice joint closures, ethernet cabling products, and active optical components; and defence solutions, including electro optics, electronic fuzes, ground surveillance radar, high-capacity radio relay, and software defined radios. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~30% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~1% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 13.4% cost of equity).
PE of 33 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 58), though that is a short history to judge by.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 36% a year while PE moved 33 → 33.
